source_description: 10-minute delivery for selected fast-prep items.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Speed / convenience; priority delivery allocation; management says fast-prep and short distances can reduce last-mile cost.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: 700+ cities; >10% of food orders in Q1FY26; Bolt+99-Store >25% food volumes by Q2FY27.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Does faster delivery improve or worsen cost/order after controlling for order mix and density?

source_description: Premium subscription proposition with faster delivery.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Retention / premium experience / subscription engagement.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Named as a food growth proposition; no separate quantified P&L impact in supplied letters.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Avoid attributing platform-wide margin or retention to it without cohort evidence.

source_description: Opt-in batching mode for selected delivery orders.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Improve delivery density and utilisation without degrading service to remaining users.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: No standalone quantified uplift disclosed.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Need data on batch rate, delivery distance, partner utilisation and service level.

source_description: Single-serve, fast-prep meal propositions priced around ₹99.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Affordability and lower delivery radius / batching; acquire budget-sensitive users.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: 175+ cities and high-single-digit order share in Q1/Q2FY26; combined Bolt+99-Store >25% volumes in Q2FY27.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Potential AOV dilution; compare contribution/order and incremental customer acquisition.

source_description: Standalone quick-food / functional meal proposition.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Test a new use-case / purchase mission.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Shut down in Q4FY26 because management was unconvinced of steady-state category size relative to operating complexity.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Portfolio-pruning case study; document product-market-fit evidence and stop decision.

source_description: Standalone affordability app / marketplace for affordable restaurant meals.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Acquire price-sensitive users at a fraction of new-marketplace infrastructure cost; incremental reach and cross-sell.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: 50+ cities; two-thirds new/dormant users; cross-user combined frequency +25%; oldest-city repeat-user economics positive (management statement).
status_as_of_Q2FY27: live; scaling and sustainability under evaluation
analytical_questions_or_risks: No public counterfactual or complete cohort economics; platform innovations carries losses.

source_description: Health-forward range such as high-protein, low-calorie and no-added-sugar options.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Selection differentiation / higher intent and potentially higher basket.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: ~1 in 9 orders in Q3FY26; later described as >15% food volumes in selected context (confirm scope before trend comparison).
analytical_questions_or_risks: Source statements may use different definitions/periods; avoid treating them as directly comparable.

source_description: Workplace/tech-park-oriented food proposition.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: New consumption occasion / office users.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Reported presence across 7,000+ tech parks in 30 cities.
analytical_questions_or_risks: No standalone order or contribution economics disclosed.

source_description: Food ordering for train journeys.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Expand addressable consumption occasions and distribution.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Availability cited at 115+ stations.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Need order count, repeat rate, service quality and commission/fulfilment economics.

source_description: Cart-within-a-cart / larger-basket value proposition.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Raise basket size and wallet share; potentially lower per-order fulfilment cost.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Management attributes part of AOV and basket-growth journey to it; no isolated uplift.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Promotional investment can depress contribution margin; test customer cohorts and order economics.

source_description: Larger darkstore format supporting expanded assortment.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Increase assortment depth and service capability; support non-grocery expansion.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Store network/area grows substantially; no direct causal attribution.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Store capex, utilisation, inventory holding and maturation time.

source_description: Quick-commerce sale/event co-created with brands before festive period.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Brand partnership, non-grocery awareness and category expansion.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: GOV growth acceleration described as 24.2% QoQ during Q2FY26.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Promotional orders may not reflect steady-state retention or profitability.

source_description: Curated brand partnerships offering higher-quality/value-forward alternatives.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Differentiated assortment and retention rather than price/speed alone.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: 400+ brands; 50 categories at Q1FY27; Q2FY27 over 20% of orders across 60+ categories; one example: 51% of high-protein atta category growth in four months.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Need attribution, gross margin, repeat cohorts and category-specific denominator.

source_description: Clean-food private brand and private-label assortment.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Differentiated selection, brand stickiness and potentially improved economics.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: At Q2FY27 more than one in eight orders across 500+ SKUs; buyers reported ~15pp higher retention.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Retention comparison may be selection-biased; examine matched cohorts and gross margin / working capital.

source_description: Curated fresh fruits and vegetables offering, launched in Bengaluru.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Quality/assortment differentiation for grocery consumption occasions.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: One in six customers bought Nectr, per Q2FY27 management discussion.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Need repeat purchase, wastage, fulfilment, margin and city-level scale evidence.

source_description: Single-dish dining deals.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Offer-led restaurant discovery and dine-in frequency.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: No standalone financial impact disclosed.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Discount funding and incremental versus cannibalised restaurant visits.

source_description: QR menu with digital order and payment.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Digitise restaurant workflow and enhance transaction engagement / data.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: No standalone adoption metrics in supplied letter.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Restaurant adoption, payment conversion, customer friction and take-rate economics.

source_description: Order from cinema seat / in-cinema dining.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Add a new consumption occasion and convenience channel.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: No standalone volume disclosed.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Partner economics, service constraints and incremental demand.

source_description: Event and experiences proposition.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Increase discovery and engagement beyond standard restaurant orders.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: No independent KPI disclosed.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Need event GMV, repeat booking, partner take rate and contribution.

source_description: Flagship restaurant festival.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Increase restaurant partner depth and advertising monetisation.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Management said event accentuated partner depth and advertising monetisation.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Separate event-related GMV from sustainable revenue run-rate.

source_description: Ads and sponsored placements within consumer platforms.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Increase platform revenue without proportional increase in delivery cost; a stated food margin driver.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Food take rate 25.8% Q2FY26 and 26.1% Q2FY27; OOH advertising cited as supporting profitability; Instamart RPO includes monetisation.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Definitions, gross/net treatment, segment allocation and ad revenue concentration need careful source tracking.

source_description: Foreign shareholding cap of 49.5% fully diluted to meet IOCC requirements and enable inventory ownership.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Potential ~80bps net margin benefit; expected working-capital-cycle improvement 8–10 days; inventory model.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Domestic ownership >58% reported in Q2FY27 management commentary; transition expected to start mid-Q3FY27 and take 2–3 quarters.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Inventory ownership changes gross-versus-net accounting, stock risk, working capital and margin denominator; model both.

source_description: Partner app enabled income tax return filing.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Financial inclusion and ecosystem support.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: 50,000+ partners; ₹6.5cr cumulative refund claims; >one-third first-time filers.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Impact metrics are company-reported; no direct financial return claim.

source_description: Battery swap co-location at Instamart last-mile stations.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Improve delivery partner uptime and reduce rental expense / carbon footprint.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Management says up to 60 minutes/day saved and rental cost up to 30% lower.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Need pilot size, measurement method, cost per delivery, EV share and emissions methodology.

source_description: Facilitation of delivery partner registration on government social security portal.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Expand access to insurance, pension and worker benefits.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: About 100,000 partners registered as of Q4FY26 letter.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Do not conflate registrations with actual benefit uptake.

source_description: Sale of entire Lynks stake; separate primary investment into Udaan.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Portfolio simplification / capital reallocation; reported Supply Chain segment changes from Q3FY27.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: ~₹500cr sale consideration; separate ₹75cr investment for ~3.2% in Udaan; expected ~₹20cr segment EBITDA benefit from removing Lynks.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Create discontinuity marker; sale proceeds and primary investment are distinct transaction types.

source_description: ₹10,000cr QIP plus ₹2,400cr unlock from stake sale in Rapido.
management_stated_economic_or_strategic_: Strengthen balance sheet and finance long-term investment strategy.
quantified_evidence_disclosed: Management said QIP completed in late Dec-25; report calls QIP second largest in India outside BFSI.
analytical_questions_or_risks: Separate equity financing from operating cash flow; assess dilution and cash deployment.
